note.explanation: JavaScript is a programming language that is used to make websites interactive and engaging. It can respond to actions such as clicks, read information entered in a form, and change page content or styles.
examples: When a button is clicked, JavaScript can display an alert message.
JavaScript can change a page's background color when a button is clicked.
note.simple: HTML provides the page elements, and JavaScript makes them respond to users.
note.checkQuestion: Which HTML event runs when a user clicks an element?
note.title: Introduction to JavaScript
steps: Put the JavaScript code in a <script> element or link an external JavaScript file.
Write a function to perform the task.
Connect the function to an event, such as onclick.
When the event occurs, the function runs.
note.answer: JavaScript makes web pages interactive by responding to user actions and input.

options: To make websites interactive and engaging
To create only the structure of a webpage
To store images on a computer
mcqs.stem: What is a main use of JavaScript on a website?
rationales: Correct: JavaScript can make pages interactive and respond to user actions.
Incorrect: HTML provides the structure of a webpage.
Incorrect: JavaScript is not used to store images on a computer.
Incorrect: JavaScript does not replace HTML elements.

mcqs.stem: Which statement stores 15 as a Number in a JavaScript variable?
rationales: Incorrect: The quotes make 15 a String.
Correct: The number has no quotes, so it is stored as a Number.
Incorrect: true is a Boolean value, not the number 15.
Incorrect: Brackets make this an Array.

mcqs.stem: Which statement assigns a Boolean value to a variable?
rationales: Incorrect: Quotation marks make the value a String.
Correct: true without quotation marks is a Boolean value.
Incorrect: The square brackets make this an Array.
Incorrect: 1 is a Number, not a Boolean value.

mcqs.stem: Which is the correct way to begin declaring a function named greet?
rationales: Correct: The function keyword is followed by the function name and parentheses.
Incorrect: The function name and keyword are in the wrong order.
Incorrect: This is not the function declaration syntax shown in the section.
Incorrect: This does not declare a function using the section's syntax.

mcqs.stem: Which event is triggered when a user clicks an HTML element?
rationales: Incorrect: onload is triggered when a page or image has finished loading.
Correct: onclick is triggered when an element is clicked.
Incorrect: onmouseout is triggered when the pointer moves out of an element.
Incorrect: onkeyup is triggered when a keyboard key is released.

mcqs.stem: Which expression gets the value entered in the input element whose id is name?
rationales: Correct: The value property gets the input field's entered value.
Incorrect: The style property refers to styling, not the entered text.
Incorrect: This does not get the input field's entered value.
Incorrect: The title property does not return the input's entered value.

mcqs.stem: Which HTML markup links the external file script.js as JavaScript?
rationales: Correct: A script element with the src attribute links an external JavaScript file.
Incorrect: javascript is not the HTML tag used to include a JavaScript file.
Incorrect: The link element is not used this way to include a JavaScript file.
Incorrect: The code element does not link an external JavaScript file.

mcqs.stem: Which JavaScript statement changes the page background color to lightblue?
rationales: Correct: It sets the body's backgroundColor style property to the string lightblue.
Incorrect: It leaves out the style property used to change a CSS property.
Incorrect: It does not use the section's JavaScript property path or quote the color.
Incorrect: The document, style, and body parts are in the wrong order.

written.text: Q8.5. How can you include JavaScript in an HTML file?
written.finalAnswer: JavaScript can be written inside a <script> element in the HTML file or linked from an external file using <script src="script.js"></script>.

rubric.why: The script element allows JavaScript code to be included in the HTML document.

A long question may ask for a complete program, such as changing a background color after a button click. Include the HTML button, its onclick attribute, the function, and the correct style property.
Marks are commonly earned for correct syntax, connecting the event to the function, writing the action inside the function, and briefly explaining what happens.
For variables, use quotation marks for strings, but not for numbers or Boolean values.

explain.title: What JavaScript does
explain.body: JavaScript is a programming language that is used to make websites interactive and engaging. It can make things happen after a user clicks a button, moves the mouse, or enters information.

explain.title: Variables hold information
explain.body: A variable is like a container that holds information which can be used and manipulated in your code. JavaScript uses var, let, or const to declare variables. Strings use quotes, while numbers and Boolean values do not.

explain.title: Functions reuse code
explain.body: Functions allow you to reuse code and perform specific tasks. A function can take parameters, which are placeholders for values passed to it. Calling the function makes its code run.

explain.title: Events connect users to code
explain.body: An event is an action that occurs when a user interacts with a webpage, like clicking a button or pressing a key. An event handler is a function that runs when a specific event occurs.

mistakes: Leaving quotation marks off a String, or adding quotation marks around a Number or Boolean value.
Declaring a function but forgetting to call it or connect it to an event such as onclick.
Using the wrong event name; for example, onclick is for a click, while onload is for a page or image finishing loading.
Forgetting .value when reading what a user typed into an input field.
Writing a CSS property change without the correct path, such as document.body.style.backgroundColor.
